title: PG&E Soars After Regulator Signals No Bankruptcy Interest
主要内容: PG&E Corp. saw its stock rise by 49% in extended trading after California Public Utilities Commission head Michael Picker stated that allowing the state's largest utility to go bankrupt amid potential liability from deadly wildfires would be poor policy. Picker emphasized the need for stability and economic support to ensure the utility can finance essential services and infrastructure.
